description: Defines the AtRootBlock class, a specialized block within the SCSSPHP library used for handling @at-root directives in SCSS.

classes.name: AtRootBlock
classes.description: A class representing an @at-root block in the SCSSPHP parser, extending the generic Block class and setting its type appropriately.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AtRootBlock and sets its type to T_AT_ROOT.
